llm.summary: This skill is a simple review prompt for finding unnecessary code complexity and does not contain executable behavior or hidden access requests.

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is to review diffs for over-engineering and produce concise deletion or simplification suggestions; the artifact content matches that purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Instructions are narrowly scoped to review output style and explicitly exclude correctness, security, and performance review rather than attempting broader authority.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The package contains only a markdown SKILL.md file with no executable scripts, dependencies, hooks, or install-time commands.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill only needs access to user-provided diffs or code context for review; it does not request credentials, network access, filesystem indexing, or external tools.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No persistence, privilege escalation, background processes, profile/session access, or data mutation behavior is present in the artifacts.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install this if you want a deliberately narrow review mode focused on cutting unnecessary complexity. It is not a full code review skill, so use a separate review pass for bugs, security issues, and performance concerns.
